scope: Fail closed on observed edits to explicitly audited source files; prerequisite reliability work, not persistent audit caching
defect: Compiler AST, source-offset interpretation and macro preprocessing could observe different versions of the same source. The old scanner accepted the negative fixture instead of rejecting it.
implementation: Capture all explicit manifest source bytes before compiler work. Check equality before a file's scan, after AST compilation, after preprocessing, and again across the manifest before returning. Interpret AST offsets using the captured source, not a later read.
negative_controls: AST-stage edits, preprocessor-stage edits, edits to a previously completed manifest entry, and edits to a queued entry; each checked with one and two workers. Pre-fix test failed with expected audit rejection; post-fix all eight reject.

verification.targeted_tests: 7/7 PASS in 35.70 s: queue, pipe, pipe census, projection, parallel/mutation, projection census and C++ auditor contracts

full_current_source_comparison.control: Existing native/build/audit-discard-full-baseline executable used in the recorded 2026-10-08 parser control, now scanning CURRENT sources
full_current_source_comparison.conditions: Sequential candidate then control; same current source tree and compiler flags; no concurrent build/test workload or source edits. Single pair, OS caches uncontrolled; no statistically supported speed claim.

verification.archived_census_note: The earlier 944-function snapshot predates committed floorplan changes. Its constants/sites matched, but function offsets and three added functions did not; it was NOT treated as an equivalent-input comparator.

regression_checkpoint: Before this production guard, all 273 configured tests had passing results across the serial repair campaign, not one clean all-suite run at one commit. The final 190-273 batch passed 84/84 in 65.23 s. The new guard was then rebuilt and verified as detailed above.
limitations: Not an atomic filesystem snapshot: an edit restored between equality checks can evade detection
Only explicit manifest files are checked; unlisted transitive headers/compiler environment are not covered
No persistent cache, skipped compiler pass, relaxed gate or shortened census introduced
Hardware/layout optimisation, fully current qualified output package and matched Python comparisons remain unfinished
